faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes SL55 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: The SL55 AMG uses the M177 - a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8. It's an AMG-designed, hand-assembled engine that's been fitted to the current-generation R232 SL since its 2021 launch.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes SL55 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500 for the M177 V8. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SL55 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact M177 specification before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M177 SL55 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components and bearings as standard on every M177 rebuild - following the established AMG specialist pattern for this engine family.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used SL55 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SL55 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SL55 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SL55 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
